# spot

> spot is a terminal pet for developers. Spot, a black labrador with a red collar, lives in your shell: a small face in your prompt, a one-second pixel-art reaction after every test run (a wag for green, comfort for red, zoomies when you fix a broken run), and a full-screen room where you pet, feed and play fetch with him. MIT licensed, written in Go, one binary, no daemon, no network.

## Install

- Homebrew: `brew install gitguy268/tap/spot-cli` (run `brew trust gitguy268/tap` first on new Homebrew)
- Go: `go install github.com/Gitguy268/spot-cli/cmd/spot@latest`
- Binaries for macOS, Linux and Windows: https://github.com/Gitguy268/spot-cli/releases/latest

## Set up

- zsh: `eval "$(spot init zsh --prompt)"` in ~/.zshrc
- bash: `eval "$(spot init bash --prompt)"` in ~/.bashrc
- fish: `spot init fish --prompt | source` in config.fish
- PowerShell: `Invoke-Expression (& spot init pwsh --prompt | Out-String)` in $PROFILE
- Without hooks: `spot run -- go test ./...` (keeps the exit code, silent when not on a terminal)
